static_traits.name: Lin Qing

basic_info.main_problem: At a weekend chess event, overall successful and rewarding, but because of a small episode of spilling water on oneself during a match, feeling frustrated, tending to ignore the positive side and over-focus on that negative event, causing the positive experience to be overshadowed.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望处理自己“negate积极、过度关注负面”的倾向，改善整体心态与对活动的享受。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在众人面前出错或丢脸，整个活动就算失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 赛后not断Reflection并聚焦于错误，淡化或忽略积极收获，以自我监督避免not yet来再犯
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失误毁了我整个周末；大家都在看我，太丢脸了

special_situations.event: 活动结束后的回顾与自我Reflection情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现一个负面细节，它比所有正向结果更重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用挑错的方式进行回顾，只记录和谈论负面部分
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 胜利和学习都not算数，关键是我把水洒了
